description:
Given the state of America, many people are thinking of leaving, but have no clue where to start. I didn’t either when I first came to Costa Rica, but after going through the entire process, I understand how it works intimately. 

In this video, I run down all the basics. You will need to know if you would like to purchase property in Costa Rica. ￼Here are some key points:
- non-citizens have no legal rights in Costa Rica, you will need to form a corporation to buy property 
-￼ you will need a lawyer to do this, but she must be wary of lawyers in Costa Rica
- Costa Rica is a cash market, financing is not really a thing
-you must understand water rights and digital plots
- this is a Spanish-speaking country and all legal documents are in Spanish
- no license is required to buy or sell real estate so anybody can be an “real estate agent”
-things move slower here than America and it can be frustrating
-the easiest path to residency is via investment which requires $150,000 expenditure

￼ Buying property here is definitely a process, but I found it to be one of the most worthwhile things I’ve ever done for me and my family. If you would like to have my help and moving here, I am available, but it is a paid service given the lengthy process & ￼multiple moving parts. SERIOUS INQUIRIES can contact me at felzmediagroup@gmail.com.
